description: Hand work to exactly one human as either an acknowledgement or a tappable question. The server verifies that one of the recipient's current devices supports the complete Handoff action before creating anything.

user_id.description: The authorizing human, expressed as the literal value "me".

data.description: Structured context returned on read surfaces after connector privacy filtering. Do not put secrets in data.

expires_in.description: Seconds before the handoff expires; the server clamps this to its safe range.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for at-most-once creation across both Ack and Question kinds.

kind.description: ack asks the human to acknowledge; question asks them to choose an option.

options.description: Required for question and forbidden for ack. Each item may be a label string or a structured option.

prompt.description: The work/request shown to the human.

urgency.description: Notification interruption level. Defaults to active.

name: create_handoff

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Create Handoff
